# IProtocolAccessManager

## IProtocolAccessManager
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/access-contracts/src/interfaces/IProtocolAccessManager.sol)

**Title:**
IProtocolAccessManager

Defines system roles and provides role based remote-access control for
contracts that inherit from ProtocolAccessManaged contract

#### generateRole

Generates a unique role identifier based on the role name and target contract address

**Notes:**
- internal-logic: 
- Combines the roleName and roleTargetContract using abi.encodePacked
- Applies keccak256 hash function to generate a unique bytes32 identifier

- effects: 
- Does not modify any state, pure function

- security-considerations: 
- Ensures unique role identifiers for different contracts
- Relies on the uniqueness of contract addresses and role names


```solidity
function generateRole(ContractSpecificRoles roleName, address roleTargetContract) external pure returns (bytes32);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`roleName`|`ContractSpecificRoles`|The name of the role (from ContractSpecificRoles enum)|
|`roleTargetContract`|`address`|The address of the contract the role is for|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bytes32`|bytes32 The generated role identifier|

### Events
#### GuardianExpirationSet
Emitted when a guardian's expiration is set


```solidity

```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`account`|`address`|The address of the guardian|
|`expiration`|`uint256`|The timestamp until which the guardian powers are valid|

### Errors
#### InvalidGuardianExpiryPeriod
Emitted when an invalid guardian expiry period is set


```solidity
error InvalidGuardianExpiryPeriod(uint256 expiryPeriod, uint256 minExpiryPeriod, uint256 maxExpiryPeriod);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`expiryPeriod`|`uint256`|The expiry period that was set|
|`minExpiryPeriod`|`uint256`|The minimum allowed expiry period|
|`maxExpiryPeriod`|`uint256`|The maximum allowed expiry period|



## ContractSpecificRoles
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/access-contracts/src/interfaces/IProtocolAccessManager.sol)

Dynamic roles are roles that are not hardcoded in the contract but are defined by the protocol
Members of this enum are treated as prefixes to the role generated using prefix and target contract address
e.g generateRole(ContractSpecificRoles.CURATOR_ROLE, address(this)) for FleetCommander, to generate the CURATOR_ROLE
for the curator of the FleetCommander contract


```solidity
enum ContractSpecificRoles {
CURATOR_ROLE,
KEEPER_ROLE,
COMMANDER_ROLE,
// V2
OPERATOR_ROLE
}
```
